title: kb_pack shows the clone's absolute path to remote clients in its kb copy line
goal: A kb served to an audience outside the team (kb_http.py, or kb_mcp.py under --roots) never puts the clone's absolute path or a git pull command in kb_pack or kb_status output: behind_note in kb_mcp.py is off or reworded without the path when the server is limited by --roots or HEAD is detached at a census tag; test_kb_http_no_local_path plants a clone behind its upstream and proves no absolute path reaches an HTTP answer
